in_sanskrit.name: Sharaz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Famous, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharaz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharat' meaning 'Famous' or 'Radiant'. It is a powerful name, associated with the sun, and carries the strength and wisdom of a warrior. This name is often given to boys born into strong and noble families.
